About the offer

eventValid until 30 Nov 2026

Celebrate National Day with an exceptional stay at IHG Hotels & Resorts worldwide.

Earn Miles and Enjoy 20% off the Best Flexible Rate when booking during the campaign period, and experience world class hospitality designed to elevate every journey; whether local or international.

From premium comfort to unforgettable service, make your next stay more rewarding with this exclusive offer for AlFursan members.

 

Offer period:

The offer is valid from 15 September to 30 November 2026.

Terms and Conditions

  • The Saudia AlFursan Offer (“Offer”) provides a minimum 20% discount on the Best Flexible Rate, which is an unrestricted, non-qualified, non-discounted rate at participating hotels for bookings and stays from 15 September to 30 November 2026.
  • The Offer is available to current, eligible Saudia AlFursan members. IHG Hotels reserves the right to request proof of AlFursan membership at check-in.
  • To redeem the Offer, guests must be members of IHG One Rewards. Membership is free. Visit ihgonerewards.com for details and enrollment.
  • Eligible AlFursan members may book through official Saudia AlFursan channels or via ihg.com/Saudia at participating IHG Hotels & Resorts.
  • Bookings must be made at least seven (7) days prior to arrival. Cancellation within 7 days of check-in will result in a one-night charge.
  • Bookings must include at least one night between Thursday and Sunday. The Offer is available until further notice.
  • The Offer is valid only at participating IHG Hotels & Resorts in select global destinations. Rates are limited and subject to availability.
  • Rate details may vary by region and hotel. Unused components of the rate are non-refundable. No retroactive points will be awarded for stays completed prior to IHG One Rewards enrollment.
  • Blackout dates may apply at selected hotels. Rates are per room, per night, and additional charges may apply for extra persons or rollaway beds. Not applicable to group bookings.
  • Additional restrictions may apply. Rates do not include taxes, gratuities, or incidental charges, including food and beverages.
  • IHG reserves the right to cancel, terminate, or amend the Offer or these terms at any time, with or without prior notice. Sections 11–15 apply to eligible IHG One Rewards members.
  • If two or more eligible members who are also IHG One Rewards members check into the same room at the same time, points will be credited only to the member who made the booking.
  • IHG One Rewards points will be deposited into the eligible member’s account within 4–6 weeks.
  • If any eligible member is found to have engaged in fraud or misuse of the Offer, IHG One Rewards reserves the right to withdraw rewards or close the member’s account.
  • This Offer qualifies for IHG One Rewards points but cannot be combined with any other offer, discount, or promotion, and has no cash value.
  • The Offer is subject to the standard IHG One Rewards program terms and conditions available via the provided link.
  • ©2026 InterContinental Hotels Group. All rights reserved. Most hotels are independently owned and/or operated.
